create_dictionary: create a dictionary mapping words to integer IDs from a list of tokenized sentences with optional frequency threshold
get_wordvec: get word vectors from a fasttext or glove vector file for words present in a given vocabulary dictionary
prepare: prepare SentEval parameters by building a word dictionary and loading word vectors from a vector file
batcher: batch encode a list of tokenized sentences into mean-pooled word vector embeddings using loaded word vectors
run_senteval_evaluation: run SentEval evaluation on 24 transfer tasks including STS benchmarks, sentiment analysis, and linguistic probes
